name: index-study
description: Create Index study sets from notes and add or remove cards in your existing sets.

interface.longDescription: Create private flashcard sets from your notes in ChatGPT. Find and read your Index sets, add cards, and remove selected cards. Connect your existing Index account with Google, approve access, and disconnect at any time in Index. Your study progress and stars remain separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into an Index study set with clear terms and definitions.
